newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen orders illegal brokerage units to close.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen orders illegal brokerage units to close.

text.p: Authorities in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen have ordered the closure of all unlicensed securities brokerage trading points, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said on Thursday.

Brokerages must shut any illegal computer terminals connected to their trading systems by April 30, the newspaper said, quoting a notice issued by the Shenzhen branch of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
Analysts said the order was aimed at stopping the practice of brokerages setting up company trading computer terminals in outside offices and in the homes of investors.
The newspaper said the operation of such terminals contravened the regulations and was interferring with Shenzhen's financial industry.

Brokerages which fail to shut the unlicensed trading terminals by the deadline face compulsory closure of the terminals, the loss of their business licence and a fine of between one and five million yuan, the newspaper said.
